proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 15$ free credit upon registration, images cost ~$0.003 each (equivalent to ~5,000 free high-quality images, no credit card required initially).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides ultra-fast, commercial-use FLUX.1-schnell generation with exceptional prompt adherence and crisp vector-like output, far superior to Pollinations.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can be integrated directly into 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_merch_designs' scripts running in GitHub Actions using a simple HTTP POST request with the 'FAL_KEY' secret.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the initial $15 credit is exhausted, it requires a pay-as-you-go top-up, though costs remain extremely low.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 15 free credits per day, access to vector export tools and commercial license under free tier attributes.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An advanced AI-powered design platform tailored specifically for POD merchandise, permitting quick generation of t-shirt layouts, text-effects, and vectorization.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used manually by Hugo on his Android phone browser to quickly package, vectorize, and polish raw AI images generated via GitHub Actions before uploading to Redbubble.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires attribution under the free tier; SVG export is sometimes restricted to premium, but high-res PNG export is free.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free interactive web use; API offers a trial quota of credits upon email verification.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts pixel-art or raster coloring book pages (PNG/JPG) into true mathematical vector SVG format with unmatched precision, essential for high-quality KDP and SVG pack sales.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Could be integrated into 'produce_svg_pack' or used manually to convert GitHub-generated coloring pages into high-end print-ready vector PDFs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Fully automated API usage eventually requires payment, but the manual web interface remains highly accessible for batch processing.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to publish; they take a 10% cut of the retail price only when a sale is made.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes ebooks and paperbacks to dozens of stores simultaneously (Barnes & Noble, Apple Books, Kobo, Scribd) from a single upload dashboard, expanding reach far beyond KDP.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline 'produce_chess_book' or 'produce_roman_chapters' can output formatted EPUBs to be uploaded here to automate multi-channel book distribution.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Formatting requirements are strict; covers must be precisely sized to avoid automated rejection during ingestion.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to upload, list, and showcase assets with no listing fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The largest repository for open-source and public domain gamedev assets; serves as an excellent traffic redirector to paid premium asset packs on itch.io or Cults3D.
proposals.would_integrate_where: In 'produce_gamedev_asset_pack', Hugo can upload a 'Lite' version of a 2D tilemap or 3D low-poly pack here, with a README link pointing to his premium packs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Licensing must be clearly specified (e.g., CC-BY or CC0) to prevent community backlash regarding AI-generated assets.

proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides structured JSON data directly from Google Search, Google Images, and Google Trends without dealing with complex scraping blocks.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integrates into 'agent_trendhunter' or 'agent_merch_trends' to automatically extract rising search queries directly from GitHub Actions.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: 100 requests per month is low, so searches must be highly targeted and cached to maximize efficiency.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free credits on sign-up, scale-as-you-go model with low-cost entry tiers.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Generates highly realistic 3D assets, video clips, or spatial scenes from simple text or image prompts, opening up 3D asset generation workflows.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Could be used in a future 'produce_3d_assets' pipeline to generate preview videos or marketing clips for Cults3D models automatically.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Heavy computational demand; API keys must be secured and call volume monitored closely to avoid unexpected usage.
